name: 118. Gemini forwarded Authorization stripped when x-goog-api-key authenticates (PR #3835)
description: Clients forward `Authorization: Bearer ...` (x-bf-eh-authorization, or a header allowlist). The Gemini provider authenticates with x-goog-api-key, so the forwarded Bearer reached Google alongside the key. Google rejects the pair: AI Studio returns 401 "Request had invalid authentication credentials", and Vertex Express (base_url overridden to aiplatform.googleapis.com) can return 401 "API keys are not supported by this API". PR #3835 strips Authorization whenever a non-empty x-goog-api-key is set (setGeminiAuthHeader, plus both streaming handlers). Each case forwards a bogus Bearer on a different Gemini wire path and asserts a clean 200: chat and responses (unary + stream), the /genai drop-in (generateContent + streamGenerateContent), embeddings and list-models.

item.name: gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite chat completions unary with forwarded Bearer - gemini-forwarded-auth

exec: pm.test('status is 200 (forwarded Authorization must not reach Gemini alongside x-goog-api-key)', function () {
pm.test('no dual-credential rejection from Google', function () {
pm.expect(text, 'upstream saw the forwarded Bearer: ' + text).to.not.include('invalid authentication credentials');
pm.expect(text, 'upstream saw the forwarded Bearer: ' + text).to.not.include('API keys are not supported by this API');
